text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I couldn't get first place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And I was so close! This is so frustratin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where's your ambition?! I was
aimin' for first
out there!
choice_data_list_en: Let's finish in 1st place next time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And my results are tied real tight to how much clout you get! So ya better toughen up, 'kay?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's head back 'n review things,
yeah?!
'Cause next time's da one! I'm
winnin' for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I swear on da White
Lightnin' name,
I'm winnin' gold next
time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no time for mopin'! Let's jump
straight
into trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I never wanna feel this way again!
